headline: Police rescue about 200 people from Mpumalanga church site
deck: Officials said some people were chained at the site in Siyabuswa; 132 had been reunited with their families.
body: Authorities found about 200 people, including minors, during an operation at a church-affiliated suspected rehabilitation centre in Waterval B, Siyabuswa. [E1]
A pastor and his wife were arrested after the discovery, the BBC reported. [E2]
Social-development officials had requested police assistance during an inspection at the church, EWN reported. [E3]
An 11-year-old boy, a 16-year-old girl and adult men aged 22 and older were among those found, Sowetan reported. [E4]
Authorities said they found grossly inhumane conditions: some patients had sores over their bodies and others were chained to each other. [E5]
Officials said 132 people had been reunited with their families. [E6]
